verdict.rationale: Temporal is a workflow orchestration platform with a Web UI, CLI, and Cloud console, so a built-in AI assistant is a plausible feature to ask about. The evidence shows no assistant inside the product that users can hand tasks to. The AI-related items (Google ADK and Vercel AI SDK integrations, orchestrating 'AI apps, and agents', AgentCore serverless workers, llms.txt) are developer building blocks for building one's own agents, not a built-in assistant, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
